# Exalt Exchange

Exalt Exchange is a global digital asset platform providing cryptocurrency trading, spot trading, futures trading, P2P services, Web3 wallet access, staking, KYC services, and access to the EXALT ecosystem.

## Official Website

- https://exaltexchange.io/

- Home: https://exaltexchange.io/

- AML Policy: https://exaltexchange.io/aml
- KYC Policy: https://exaltexchange.io/kyc-policy
- Risk Disclosure: https://exaltexchange.io/risk
- Cookie Policy: https://exaltexchange.io/cookies
- Refund Policy: https://exaltexchange.io/refund

## Platform Information

Exalt Exchange supports digital asset market information, account management, wallet services, trading interfaces, user security, compliance, and access to the EXALT ecosystem.

Public information may be accessed through the official website. Private account, wallet, KYC, administrative, and authenticated user information must not be crawled or exposed.
